dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with detected imports: b2sdk (Backblaze B2 SDK), six (Python 2/3 compatibility), packaging (package version parsing), and networkx (graph/network library). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base image, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets default command to run a Python script (replace 'your_script.py' with actual entry point).
